modal_signal: An implementation may have WFI always raise a virtual-instruction exception
excerpt: An implementation may have WFI always raise a virtual-instruction exception in VS-mode when VTW=1 (and `mstatus`.TW=0), even if there are pending globally-disabled interrupts when the instruction is executed.

modal_signal: may make PPN[1:0] read-only zero
excerpt: An implementation that supports only the defined paged virtual-memory schemes and/or Bare may make PPN[1:0] read-only zero.

modal_signal: may be read-only zero if there are no extensions implemented that utilize it
excerpt: The `miselect` register implements at least enough bits to support all implemented `miselect` values (corresponding to the implemented extensions that utilize `miselect`/`mireg*` to indirectly access register state). The `miselect` register may be read-only zero if there are no extensions implemented that utilize it.

modal_signal: it is implementation-defined whether bits MXLEN..XLEN of the destination register are unchanged or are overwritten
excerpt: When such a HINT is executed with XLEN < MXLEN and bits MXLEN..XLEN of the destination register not all equal to bit XLEN-1, it is implementation-defined whether bits MXLEN..XLEN of the destination register are unchanged or are overwritten with copies of bit XLEN-1.

modal_signal: An implementation may have WFI always raise an illegal-instruction exception
excerpt: An implementation may have WFI always raise an illegal-instruction exception in modes less privileged than M when TW=1, even if there are pending globally-disabled interrupts when the instruction is executed.

modal_signal: implementations can provide individual read/write bits
excerpt: implementations can provide individual read/write bits within `medeleg` and `mideleg` to indicate that certain exceptions and interrupts should be processed directly by a lower privilege level.

modal_signal: An implementation can choose to subset the delegatable traps
excerpt: An implementation can choose to subset the delegatable traps, with the supported delegatable bits found by writing one to every bit location, then reading back the value in `medeleg` or `mideleg` to see which bit positions hold a one.

modal_signal: the implementation may make FIOM read-only zero
excerpt: If S-mode is not supported, or if `satp`.MODE is read-only zero (always Bare), the implementation may make FIOM read-only zero.

modal_signal: is allowed to clear any outstanding LR address reservation but is not required to
excerpt: If the A extension is supported, the __x__RET instruction is allowed to clear any outstanding LR address reservation but is not required to.

modal_signal: optionally available to U-mode
excerpt: WFI is available in all privileged modes, and optionally available to U-mode.

modal_signal: may both be read-only zeros
excerpt: If a system has only one hart, or if a platform standard supports the delivery of machine-level interprocessor interrupts through external interrupts (MEI) instead, then `mip`.MSIP and `mie`.MSIE may both be read-only zeros.

modal_signal: If the stimecmp register is not implemented
excerpt: If the stimecmp register is not implemented, STIP is writable in mip

modal_signal: RNMI causes are not supported
excerpt: If the reason is an interrupt and RNMI causes are not supported, bit MXLEN-1 is set to 1, and zero is written to the least-significant bits.

modal_signal: may implement `mseccfg` such that `[s,u]seed` is a read-only constant value `0`
excerpt: Implementations may implement `mseccfg` such that `[s,u]seed` is a read-only constant value `0`.

modal_signal: implementation-specific which DEPTH value(s) are supported
excerpt: It is implementation-specific which DEPTH value(s) are supported.

modal_signal: optional MISP bit
excerpt: The optional MISP bit is set by the hardware when the recorded transfer is an instruction whose target or taken/not-taken direction was mispredicted by the branch predictor. MISP is read-only 0 when not implemented.

modal_signal: may optionally include a count of CPU cycles
excerpt: The `ctrdata` register may optionally include a count of CPU cycles elapsed since the prior CTR record.  The elapsed cycle count value is represented by the CC field, which has a 12-bit mantissa component (Cycle Count Mantissa, or CCM) and a 4-bit exponent component (Cycle Count Exponent, or CCE).

modal_signal: may implement 0..4 exponent bits in CCE
excerpt: An implementation that supports cycle counting must implement CCV and all CCM bits, but may implement 0..4 exponent bits in CCE. Unimplemented CCE bits are read-only 0.

modal_signal: optional `__x__ctrctl`.RASEMU bit is implemented
excerpt: When the optional `__x__ctrctl`.RASEMU bit is implemented and set to 1, transfer recording behavior is altered to emulate the behavior of a return-address stack (RAS).

modal_signal: may be read-only zero only if
excerpt: Bit 63 of each `mstateen` CSR may be read-only zero only if the hypervisor extension is not implemented and the matching supervisor-level `sstateen` CSR is all read-only zeros.

modal_signal: it is implementation-defined whether bits SXLEN..XLEN of the destination register are unchanged or are overwritten
excerpt: When such a HINT is executed with XLEN < SXLEN and bits SXLEN..XLEN of the destination register not all equal to bit XLEN-1, it is implementation-defined whether bits SXLEN..XLEN of the destination register are unchanged or are overwritten with copies of bit XLEN-1.

modal_signal: the implementation may make FIOM read-only zero
excerpt: If `satp`.MODE is read-only zero (always Bare), the implementation may make FIOM read-only zero.

modal_signal: may never be 32
excerpt: The bits 1:0 of `ssp` are read-only zero. If the UXLEN or SXLEN may never be 32, then the bit 2 is also read-only zero.

modal_signal: an implementation may adopt the stronger model of Total Store Ordering
excerpt: Optionally, an implementation may adopt the stronger model of Total Store Ordering, as defined in <<ztso>>.

modal_signal: may be writable or may be read-only
excerpt: Each individual bit in register `mip` may be writable or may be read-only.

modal_signal: Optionally, PMP checks may additionally apply to M-mode accesses
excerpt: Optionally, PMP checks may additionally apply to M-mode accesses, in which case the PMP registers themselves are locked, so that even M-mode software cannot change them until the hart is reset.

modal_signal: may be shared between harts on the same core
excerpt: The `mcycle` CSR may be shared between harts on the same core, in which case writes to `mcycle` will be visible to those harts.
